title: Contaminant movement around a permeable reactive barrier at Solid Waste Management Unit 12, Naval Weapons Station Charleston, North Charleston, South Carolina, 2009
citation: Vroblesky, D.A., Petkewich, M.D., and Conlon, K.J., 2010, Contaminant movement around a permeable reactive barrier at Solid Waste Management Unit 12, Naval Weapons Station Charleston, North Charleston, South Carolina, 2009: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2010-5086, map scale 1:1,176.
notes:
Groundwater-contamination report for one site (SWMU12). Pages 1-36 are front matter, text, and contaminant-distribution figures; the figure pages hold concentration labels without readable geologic content and were not extracted. No named stratigraphic units are described in this packet. Hydrogeologic framework recorded as groundwater entries. Lithologic logs of piezometers appear in later appendixes.
Pages 37-38: summary and reference list; only references about South Carolina sites or data were recorded (general remediation, sampling and mineralogy references from other places were skipped). Page 40: well-construction table (Appendix 1) recorded as well label, State Plane coordinates, installation date and ground elevation; screen depths not recorded (no schema field). Pages 41-45: monthly water-level altitudes (ft rel. NAVD 88); only the 8/28/2009 synoptic row was recorded per well. Pages 46-49: organic-compound concentrations (Appendix 3) not extracted; table continues into the next packet. 12MW-10S has no 8/28/2009 measurement.
Pages 50-62 are all Appendix 3 (concentrations of organic compounds in groundwater and surface water, August 2000 to September 2009), continued from the previous packet. The table holds only water-chemistry results by well and date (including marsh surface-water sites), which have no field in the extraction schema; nothing was extracted. No lithology, units, structures or hydrogeologic values on these pages.
Pages 63-75 are all Appendix 4 (concentrations of inorganic constituents and field properties in groundwater, August 2000 to September 2009). The table holds only water-chemistry results by well and date (alkalinity, major ions, iron, sulfate, sulfide, pH, specific conductance, temperature, turbidity), which have no field in the extraction schema; nothing was extracted. No lithology, units, structures or hydrogeologic values on these pages.
